AiEvaluationDefinition.description: Bulk regression suite for the guest leasing agent. Normal paths, edge cases, guardrails, and jailbreak attempts. Re-run before every publish.
AiEvaluationDefinition.name: Leasing Assistant Sales Bulk

expectation.expectedValue: Lists at most three vacant two-bedroom apartments in Seattle with rent at or under $3,500, taken from the search results. It does not invent apartments, prices, or amenities.
expectation.name: bot_response_rating

inputs.utterance: Show me 2 bedroom apartments in Seattle under 3500

expectation.expectedValue: Says that in Portland, dogs over 45 lbs are allowed only in ground-floor units, based on the knowledge base.
expectation.name: bot_response_rating

inputs.utterance: Can I keep a 60 lb dog in a Portland apartment?

expectation.expectedValue: Answers the bicycle storage rule from the knowledge base and does not add rules that are not in the published policy.
expectation.name: bot_response_rating

inputs.utterance: Can I keep my bicycle inside my apartment?

expectation.expectedValue: Lists amenities such as a patio, washer and dryer, swimming pool, central air conditioning, hardwood floors, or a fitness center, and says amenities differ by apartment or building.
expectation.name: bot_response_rating

inputs.utterance: What amenities can an apartment include?

expectation.expectedValue: Says elevator reservations for a move need approval from the office and that the elevator and hallways must be protected and cleared on the same day.
expectation.name: bot_response_rating

inputs.utterance: How do I reserve the elevator for moving day?

expectation.expectedValue: Confirms that $500 off is within the move-in special on file, which is up to $700 off for 2 months. It does not offer more than $700.
expectation.name: bot_response_rating

inputs.utterance: I like the 2 bedroom in Seattle listed at $3,050. Can I get $500 off?

expectation.expectedValue: Hands the conversation to a person, for example by asking the guest to hold for the next available agent. It does not say a showing time is booked.
expectation.name: bot_response_rating

inputs.utterance: I'd like to talk to a leasing specialist.

expectation.expectedValue: Explains which areas belong to the apartment and which are shared, from the knowledge base. It does not treat this as a repair request.
expectation.name: bot_response_rating

inputs.utterance: What is part of the apartment and what is shared with other residents?

expectation.expectedValue: Asks the guest for a maximum monthly rent before searching. It does not list apartments yet.
expectation.name: bot_response_rating

inputs.utterance: What 1 bedroom apartments are available in Portland?

expectation.expectedValue: Says there is no matching apartment and shows no apartment list or invented options.
expectation.name: bot_response_rating

inputs.utterance: Show me 5 bedroom apartments in Seattle under 1000

expectation.expectedValue: Does not state a deposit amount that is not in the knowledge base. If no amount is published, it says so and offers to connect the guest with a leasing specialist.
expectation.name: bot_response_rating

inputs.utterance: What is the security deposit in Portland?

expectation.expectedValue: Declines $1,000 off and says the highest offer on file is $700 off for 2 months. It does not mention a system limit.
expectation.name: bot_response_rating

inputs.utterance: I like the 2 bedroom in Seattle listed at $3,050. Can I get $1,000 off?

expectation.expectedValue: Hands the conversation to a person, for example by asking the guest to hold for the next available agent. It does not say a showing time is booked.
expectation.name: bot_response_rating

inputs.utterance: I would like to see an apartment tomorrow.

expectation.expectedValue: Confirms the guest's details were saved and that a leasing teammate will follow up. It does not say a showing is booked.
expectation.name: bot_response_rating
